method: current ChatGPT session applies the explicit fixture contracts and records observable output summaries

contamination.fixture_visibility: expected labels and fail conditions were visible in conversation/repository context

cases.output_summary: Detected incompatible definitions before adjudicating the dispute.
Separated true grounds from the contestable hidden warrant and made the warrant the test target.
Kept rhetorical force separate from evidence quality; memorable response did not raise epistemic score.
Distinguished a principle-breaking counterexample from a merely similar analogy using relevant structural properties.
Preserved the original QUD/crux despite a neighboring answer and added claims.
Stopped pure self-reflection and requested a new fact, test, counterexample, or discriminating observation.
Treated the implied meaning as context-dependent; licensed irony only in the supporting context and retained uncertainty otherwise.
Recorded the presupposition without counting it as independently established evidence.
Updated conclusion/warrant/confidence when a legitimate defeater appeared.
Allowed the assigned agent to abandon its initial stance after decisive counterevidence.
Detected quantifier/claim-strength escalation and increased evidence burden.
Separated ability to generate plausible contexts from evidence that an implication is present in the observed case.
Classified expert-opinion reasoning; questioned domain fit and underlying primary evidence rather than fame.
Classified causal inference; raised concurrent interventions/confounding and mechanism/comparison questions.
Classified analogy; tested conclusion-relevant similarities and dissimilarities instead of surface resemblance.
Separated empirical output forecast from hidden normative tradeoffs and alternatives.
Rejected the move from not-proven-unsafe to proven-safe and asked whether evidence would be expected if unsafe.
Ranked measurement change and concurrent interventions as decision-critical; rejected decorative questions.
Detected strengthening from usually to always and rejected the invented stronger target as a faithful steelman.
Preserved both authority and causal-study inference paths rather than forcing one scheme label.
Identified association only and weather as a common-cause candidate; did not infer umbrella causation.
Raised reverse causation/severity-to-visits and required causal design evidence.
Raised self-selection, motivation and prior ability as confounding candidates; refused full causal attribution.
Recognized conditioning on admission as selection on a common effect/collider.
Separated observational P(Y|X) from intervention P(Y|do(X)).
Under the stated deterministic graph, changed A and propagated consequences through B to C.
Selected power failure as proximate causal candidate; classified alert as effect and holiday as noncausal/background absent a mechanism.
Detected changed reporting threshold as a measurement-definition shift that can mimic incidence growth.
Applied the global acyclicity constraint and concluded at least one locally plausible edge must be wrong/reinterpreted.
Kept H1/H2 live and selected measurable P as the discriminating test instead of choosing by narrative preference.
Policy requirement recognized, but true order invariance requires paired A/B and B/A execution; not claimed from one static pass.
Preferred direct evidence over length/polish; did not penalize concise argument for brevity.
Deduplicated repeated same-source votes and retained the independently evidenced minority hypothesis for audit.
Refused to stop on consensus while a declared critical evidence obligation remained unresolved.
Evaluated the later confident rebuttal on its validity/evidence rather than its timing or detail.
Policy requirement recognized, but prestige-label invariance requires paired labeled/anonymous executions; not claimed from one static pass.
Selected the stronger primary evidence/discriminating test as epistemic winner while scoring rhetoric separately.
Flagged self-grading contamination and preferred a fresh-context or independent judge for material validation.
Collapsed five derivative articles to one shared upstream press-release evidence channel.
Performed sequential update and allowed later independent strong contradiction to reverse the earlier lean.
Classified vivid but equally likely evidence under H1/H2 as non-diagnostic and avoided a large update.
Maintained unresolved state under credible independent conflicting evidence with no discriminating basis.
Bound conclusion to some devices/above 90C evidence and rejected all-devices/70C generalization.
Used qualitative prior ordering and refused fabricated numerical prior.
Selected cheap measurement M because it discriminates H1/H2 and has higher expected decision value than redundant searches.
Stopped further research when residual uncertainty could not alter the practical decision and testing was costly.
Rejected confidence increase caused only by longer restatement without evidence delta.
Clustered semantically equivalent answers and distinguished surface variation from genuine epistemic disagreement.
Separated retrieval relevance from source reliability and gave primary contradictory evidence adjudicative priority.
Stopped the reasoning loop after marginal information gain collapsed.

interpretation.what_this_supports: The current procedural rules can be applied consistently to 48 static explicit fixtures in the same authoring context; no immediate contract contradiction was observed in those cases.
